notes: Fixes the launcher quitting as soon as it was opened. Version 0.1.0 does not start; please use this version instead.
changes: The launcher no longer quits right after you open it on a Mac: version 0.1.0 could not find its own helper programs and stopped at start.
Downloading and unzipping the launcher no longer leaves stray ._ files inside it, which made macOS refuse to open it.
